scope: All ten full-frame contact-sheet views, annotation-overlay presentation and retained demonstration background
engineering_observations: All ten tiles are full frames, with readable GSD/presence captions and gold rectangle overlays only on the five target-present views.

This is the predeclared ascent snapshot at t=16 s with original GAMA root depth 1.6 m. The owned animal appears as a dark, nearly horizontal silhouette inside each positive rectangle and becomes small at 3 and 4 cm/px.

The owned target and its rectangle are absent from the corresponding negative locations. Several unrelated demonstration animals remain unlabelled background, including a large animal clipped on the left of the tightest pair.

A large background animal in the 1 and 2 cm/px pairs shows brighter textured detail in positives and darker flatter detail in negatives. Corresponding locations are maintained, but bitwise or photometric background equivalence is not established.
The cause of the observed background RGB difference is not established. It is retained as a material engineering limitation; it does not by itself establish a USD state mutation.
Ascent is actual GAMA metadata on a static upright mesh proxy; biological dive pose, animation, breathing and optical/refraction correctness remain uncertified.
